capabilities: Show a PDF preview when hovering a paper node in the graph
Edit short relation labels on graph edges and save them to the source Markdown note
Lock focus on a clicked node and unlock by clicking empty canvas
Resolve PDF sources from YAML properties, embeds, or direct links
Open the original PDF in a browser when a publisher embed fails
disambiguation: Not a standalone graph tool or citation manager; it only annotates Obsidian's existing native Graph view.
extras: Desktop-only, needs Obsidian 1.14.4+; relies on undocumented internal graph APIs that future Obsidian updates can break. Local-first with no account or telemetry; an optional legacy INSES-overview importer exists. Never fabricates edges: labels appear only on real wikilink connections backed by a relation note.
intentEvidence: It does not replace Obsidian's force-directed graph or create a second graph page.
problem: Obsidian's native graph shows bare, unlabeled edges between paper notes and offers no way to preview the linked PDF or see what a relationship means while browsing.

relations.evidence: Independent implementation inspired by the public approaches of Graph Edge Notes and Graph Highlight Lock.
Independent implementation inspired by the public approaches of Graph Edge Notes and Graph Highlight Lock.

summary: Graph view enhancement that adds hover PDF previews for paper notes and editable short labels on existing graph edges.
